definitions.explanation: Feeling the need or desire to sleep. The state of being tired and wanting to sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{眠|ねむ}い⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{眠|ねむ}い⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'm sleepy because I couldn't sleep well yesterday.

examples.japanese: {眠|ねむ}く⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦きました→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{眠|ねむ}くて、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できませんでした→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was sleepy since morning and couldn't do my work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{眠|ねむ}そうな⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The children were playing until late at night, so today they have very sleepy faces.

notes:
{眠|ねむ}い is an i-adjective describing the state of feeling sleepy or drowsy.

FORMS:
- Verb: ⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧ (to sleep)
- Noun: ⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠り：13673_nemuri⟧ (sleep), {眠|ねむ}さ (sleepiness)
- Adverb: {眠|ねむ}く ({眠|ねむ}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ = to become sleepy)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {眠|ねむ}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become sleepy
- {眠|ねむ}そう: to look sleepy
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{眠|ねむ}い: very sleepy
- {眠|ねむ}くて⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: so sleepy I can't help it
- {眠|ねむ}い⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こする→擦る：04262_kosuru⟧: to rub sleepy eyes

KANJI COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧: sleep (formal)
- ⟦{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}→睡眠不足：08690_suiminbusoku⟧: lack of sleep
- ⟦{仮眠|かみん}→仮眠：08333_kamin⟧: nap
- ⟦{安眠|あんみん}→安眠：12266_anmin⟧: restful sleep

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧: tired (physical exhaustion)
- ⟦だるい→だるい：05307_darui⟧: sluggish, listless
- {眠|ねむ}たい: sleepy (variant, slightly more casual)

USAGE:
{眠|ねむ}い specifically describes wanting to sleep, while ⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧ is about physical/mental exhaustion. You can be ⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧ without being {眠|ねむ}い, and vice versa.

cross_references.label: to be tired (exhaustion, distinct from sleepy)
